mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.description, p.image_url AS imageUrl, c.id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, ps.stock_quantity AS stockQuantity FROM products p INNER JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id INNER JOIN product_stocks ps ON p.id = ps.product_id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted = FALSE
